description: This file defines the 'TeamMember' struct and related types and functions for managing team members in the Mattermost application, including validation, serialization, and utility functions.

classes.name: TeamMember
classes.description: Represents a member of a team, including roles, status, and identifiers.

classes.name: TeamUnread
classes.description: Tracks unread message counts and mentions for a team.

classes.name: TeamMemberForExport
classes.description: Extends TeamMember with additional export-related data, such as team name.

classes.name: TeamMemberWithError
classes.description: Wraps a TeamMember with an associated error, used for error handling.

classes.name: EmailInviteWithError
classes.description: Associates an email address with an error, used in email invitation processes.

classes.name: TeamMembersGetOptions
classes.description: Options for retrieving team members, including sorting and view restrictions.

classes.name: TeamInviteReminderData
classes.description: Contains data related to invite reminder intervals.

methods.name: Auditable
methods.description: Returns a map of the TeamMember's data for auditing purposes.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the TeamMember's data, returning an error if invalid.

methods.name: GetRoles
methods.description: Returns the roles of the team member as a slice of strings.
